run_training_job: run the training script to launch a SLURM job for fine-tuning a Llama model on a dataset
launch_slurm_job: launch a SLURM job with a custom sbatch script and optional dependency on an existing job id
configure_training_params: configure training parameters including learning rate, batch size, nodes, and training steps via CLI arguments
download_s3_dataset: download a dataset from an S3 path to a local scratch directory before training
resume_training: resume a previous training run by specifying a checkpoint path with the resume flag
